title: 飞船建造与自定义选项有限
description: 飞船建造系统部件种类少，不支持多层结构，自定义选项（如太空服、背包、工具）缺乏多样性，限制了玩家的创造力和个性化体验。
evidence: Building your own space ship is fun, but is also hampered by the limited variety of parts there are.
for a ship builder, there is a lack of component parts to choose
apesar de ser todo 3d, não existe a possibilidade de ter uma nave em níveis (primeiro andar, segundo, etc)

evidence_items.quote: Lack of variety in a lot of aspects, especially for ships (Ex: a single RCS, single power source). Quite a few derelicts are practically new because there is no 'obsolete' parts or technologies.
evidence_items.description: 船只等方面缺乏多样性，例如单一RCS、单一电源；废弃船几乎全新因为没有过时部件或技术
evidence_items.quote_zh: 很多方面缺乏多样性，尤其是飞船（例如：只有一个RCS、单一电源）。不少废弃船只几乎全新，因为游戏里没有“过时”的部件或技术。

evidence_items.quote: apesar de ser todo 3d, não existe a possibilidade de ter uma nave em níveis (primeiro andar, segundo, etc)
evidence_items.description: 游戏虽然是全3D，但不支持建造多层结构的飞船。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 尽管全是3D的，却不可能拥有一艘分层的飞船（一层、二层等等）

evidence_items.quote: two bags the entirety of the game. you expect me to believe this literally solar system spanning society is reliant on TWO types of bags and theyre not even actual backpacks?
evidence_items.description: 整个游戏只有两种包，缺乏真实感
evidence_items.quote_zh: 两个袋子就是整个游戏的全部。你指望我相信这个字面意义上横跨太阳系的社会只依赖两种袋子，而且它们甚至都不是真正的背包？

evidence_items.quote: SHIP BUILDING AND DESIGN LACKS SERIOUS DEPTH
evidence_items.description: 飞船建造和设计缺乏深度，装饰和功能部件种类少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 飞船建造和设计缺乏真正的深度

evidence_items.quote: Building your own space ship is fun, but is also hampered by the limited variety of parts there are.
evidence_items.description: 建造飞船受限于部件种类有限
evidence_items.quote_zh: 建造自己的太空飞船很有趣，但也因可用部件种类有限而受到限制。

evidence_items.quote: there isn't much content in some areas such as equipment with most functional ship parts having only one example per class
evidence_items.description: 装备内容不足，多数功能性飞船部件每类只有一个示例
evidence_items.quote_zh: 某些方面的内容不多，比如装备方面，大多数可用的飞船部件每个等级只有一个例子

evidence_items.quote: for a ship builder, there is a lack of component parts to choose
evidence_items.description: 飞船建造可选部件种类太少
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对于一个飞船建造者来说，缺乏可供选择的组件部件

evidence_items.quote: YOU CAN NOT CUSTOMISE YOUR SUIT! For me this needs to be a feature. I was so disappointed that you can only have two types of space suits
evidence_items.description: 无法自定义太空服，只有两种类型
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你不能自定义你的宇航服！对我来说这必须得是个功能。你只能有两种类型的宇航服，我太失望了
